logo.caveat: The generic startup reader defaults to profile 1 but is gated by persistentInHardware.logoLighting, which product 581 does not enable. Use profile 0 from the actual setter; the paired getter accepts that selector.
logo.basis: The actual product UI enables showLogoLighting and declares its own LOGO_EFFECTS. Middleware uses profile 0; paired helpers accept class 0 and validate the response class, LED and value.

keyboardEffects.readback: NotEstablished: only the inherited generic 0F/82 method and six-byte-header parser were found, without an actual product 581 caller or matching 03/8A old-matrix getter.
keyboardEffects.ownership: Do not fabricate an effect/RGB baseline, reinterpret generic modern readback, or inherit Blade 18 restoration or frame handling.

frames.bounds: NotEstablished here: the frame loop consumes external eventData.numRow/numCol. Family 7 and payload capacity do not independently establish row geometry or a layout mask.

battery.reason: The exact product 581 power configuration enables hasSystemPower, with no hasBatteryOptimizer flag or defaults. Shared battery getters and reducers exist, but actual read paths require hasBatteryOptimizer. Inheritance alone does not admit commands for this model.

manualFans.power: Confirmed full-power AC only; Automatic handback remains available on battery
manualFans.effectiveRange: Intersection of fresh, ordered, nonzero firmware min/default/max with the source envelope. Validate before manual entry, every target SET and paired target readback; curve entry uses the fresh maximum.
manualFans.customManual: Not admitted: exact product UI omits Custom manual support.
manualFans.discovery: Read the confirmed current preset directly. Do not reproduce vendor initialization writes across presets.
manualFans.directTransitions: Fixed/Curve subtype changes in the same confirmed admitted preset use the same typed target path without Automatic/Balanced writes.
